says: The pipeline queue makes `Land` with Schema `make` using the caller's queue name as `reply`, typed `string` while the field is `Schema.NonEmptyString`.
proof: In: next/programs/pipeline/src/Queue.ts:96 the exported `queue({ name, settings })` takes `name: string` from its caller. Make: next/programs/pipeline/src/Queue.ts:115 `Land.make({ ref: String(attempt), change: entry.change, head: entry.head, reply: name })`, whose `reply` is `Schema.NonEmptyString` (next/programs/pipeline/src/Mail.ts:11), so `queue({ name: "" })` throws in `update` on the first land.
cost: A queue built with an empty name dies with a defect inside its update on the first land, where before #1619 the child decoded its input. Only tests call `queue` today, with a constant name, so the cost is low.
